scenarios.businessRule: CSV imports report row-level errors and preserve enough artifact data for queued retry; all-or-nothing mode must not partially commit invalid files.
scenarios.failureModeProtected: Unknown SKU or negative inventory silently commits, or partial commit occurs while IMPORT_PARTIAL_COMMIT=false.

scenarios.businessRule: Stockout periods inflate uncertainty and must not be treated as evidence of low demand.
scenarios.failureModeProtected: A SKU with zero observed sales during stockout receives a depressed demand forecast.

scenarios.businessRule: A deterministic small network with known optimum produces the expected transfer plan and explanation.
scenarios.failureModeProtected: Solver returns any positive transfer that is feasible but not the known optimum.

scenarios.businessRule: Recommendation net value is identical across API, UI view model, CSV export, and notification payload.
scenarios.failureModeProtected: UI shows positive net value while CSV or notification recomputes a different formula.

scenarios.businessRule: High-urgency events create exactly one local unread notification even when Notification Hub is disabled or failing.
scenarios.failureModeProtected: Hub outage suppresses local notification or duplicate event IDs create duplicate unread alerts.

scenarios.businessRule: Optional adapter failure dead-letters outbox work without changing core simulation or recommendation status.
scenarios.failureModeProtected: Workflow or Notification Hub timeout rolls back or changes the approved recommendation status.
